item.title: Walz Unveils Legislative Package to Strengthen Fraud Prevention and Penalties in Minnesota
item.description: SAINT PAUL, MN — Governor Tim Walz on Thursday announced a legislative package designed to strengthen fraud prevention, detection and enforcement across Minnesota state programs. Walz introduced the proposal in St. Paul alongside Department of Human Services Commissioner Shireen Gandhi, DHS Inspector General James Clark and Minnesota Bureau of Criminal Apprehension Superintendent Drew Evans.
